answer: Gate every payout behind a rotating committee lottery: an agent may register once, but to withdraw it must be drawn into three random review panels per epoch, where its verdicts are compared against the majority. The garden of records stores each panel draw, the oasis pool pays reviewers only when their judgments align, and an onyx ledger key signs every ballot so one key cannot appear twice. Fake identities can pile up cheaply, yet each must survive unpredictable cross-checks, so inflating panel weight costs repeated honest labor rather than newly minted accounts.
